title: UAAP: NUNS deals UST its first loss in boys' volleyball
summary: National University-Nazareth School emerged triumphant in a five-set thriller to end University of Santo Tomas' unbeaten run in the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament on Friday.
